title: The iPhone Upgrade Program is being replaced by Apple Upgrade
summary: Apple is transitioning from the iPhone Upgrade Program to a new Apple Upgrade program, which offers customers an easier way to finance and upgrade their iPhones on an annual basis with the latest models.
problem_solved: Simplifies iPhone financing and annual upgrade options for consumers.
why_valuable: Provides accessible payment options for customers to get the latest iPhone every year with flexible financing terms.
